title: Vinyl Buried CDs After 34 Years On Top
source: RIAA Year-End Music Industry Revenue Reports, US physical format revenue: vinyl $395M (2017), $419M (2018), $504M (2019), $626M (2020), $1,000M (2021), $1,200M (2022), $1,350M (2023); CD $1,100M (2017), $698M (2018), $615M (2019), $483M (2020), $584M (2021), $482M (2022), $537M (2023). Vinyl revenue overtook CD revenue in 2020, the first time since 1987.
